scope: One independent timing replication, then gated paired original-prompt GenEval
prompts: A red apple on a white plate.
A blue bicycle parked beside a yellow wall.
Two dogs playing on green grass.
A small wooden cabin beside a lake, with mountains in the background.
A ceramic teapot to the left of a glass cup on a table.
A street market at night, with warm lights and people walking.

gate.policy: Unchanged all-pairs-faster and median reduction >=5% in BOTH comparisons; failure stops without retries or threshold changes.

arms.D: C plus guarded upstream refiner dispatch
arms.F: D plus same static context hoisting

timing_scope: CUDA-synchronized pipeline wall time including prompt encoding, sampling and VAE decode; excludes loading, trace collection, image saving and equality checks
correctness_scope: per-branch model predictions and cache schedule, scheduler latents, final image pixels; checks RNG state; tested samples only
negative_prompt: (((deformed))), blurry, over saturation, bad anatomy, disfigured, poorly drawn face, mutation, mutated, (extra_limb), (ugly), (poorly drawn hands), fused fingers, messy drawing, broken legs censor, censored, censor_bar
correctness_cases: unmodified B vs adapted B and B repeat
B vs C, C vs D, C vs E, E vs F on prompt 0, seed 11
C vs D with CFG range [0.2,0.8]
C vs D reference editing using original B generated image, seed 11, image CFG 2, prompt Make the apple green while keeping the plate white.
all timed pairs compare final pixels/PNG and RNG
prior_pilot: Preserved separately, including 1/18 slower pair and failed primary all-faster gate. Never replace or discard.
replication: Same six pilot prompts/seeds, four repeats, 24 C/D pairs and eight E/F pairs; reverse original starting order. Only one predeclared replication. Not a new six-prompt generalization claim.
prediction: CADD expected to retain approximately 8-10 percent median reduction versus matched strong controls with exact tested outputs. No promise of every pair faster.

geneval.baseline: C: OmniGen2 + TaylorSeer with last-layer-only history/prediction
geneval.quality: Independently run unchanged official GenEval scorer for both arms. Equality relative to TaylorSeer, not uncached OmniGen2.
